newsitem.title: USA: Harman foresees FY Q3 shr $0.50 to $0.55.
newsitem.headline: Harman foresees FY Q3 shr $0.50 to $0.55.

text.p: Harman International said Monday it expected earnings for the fiscal third quarter to range between $0.50 a share and $0.55 against $0.86 for the same period the previous year.
The company said sales for the period ended March 31 would likely total about 5.0 percent more than the $339.3 million reported a year ago, but about $40 million lower than expected.

It said delays in the receipt of letters of credit for several professional audio contracts with some countries would postpone shipments of $10 million. Soft consumer sales worldwide would reduce sales by another $10 million, it added.

The company also said it expected "strong" results in its fourth fiscal quarter ending June 30, as well as in fiscal 1998 due to the introduction of new products and release of the contracts for its professional audio business.
Harman International Industries Inc makes high-fidelity consumer audio products.
